mprParametrization.t95: The strategy filters apply to all rules for which no own filters elements are populated. If only the category filter is filled in the strategy filter and only the parameter filter is filled in the rule filter, the result will be a combined filter with specified categories and parameters. And vice versa, in the strategy filter you can set only categories, and in the rule filter only parameters. If both the category filter and the parameter filter are filled in the rule, the strategy filter will be ignored

mprParametrization.t109: When processing rule - committing changes in the document will be performed after all expressions of one rule are processed. mprParametrization.t110: When processing strategy - committing changes in the document will be performed after all strategy rules have been processed. mprParametrization.t145: The pre-filter narrows down the set of elements for all rules of the strategy at once. Unlike the strategy filter, it is not substituted for an unfilled rule filter but is applied in addition to it: an element will be processed only if it passes both the pre-filter and the rule filter. For example, if the pre-filter specifies the "Walls" category and the "Structural" parameter, all rules will operate only on structural walls, selecting elements among them by their own categories and parameters. An empty pre-filter imposes no restrictions

mprParametrization.sld1: Strategy processes elements without considering their relationships to other elements. At least one filter (by category or by parameter) must be filled
mprParametrization.sld2: Strategy processes instances of families without considering their relationships to other elements. It is acceptable not to use a filter by category or filter by parameter
mprParametrization.sld3: Strategy processes types. If the "Process picked elements" option is selected, then the types of the selected elements will be processed. If the "Process elements on current View" option is selected, then the types of elements on the current View will be processed. If the "Process elements in the document" option is selected then all types in the document are processed
mprParametrization.sld4: Strategy processes elements that have information about the Hosts. Such elements include: Rebar, Area Reinforcement, Path Reinforcement, Rebar Container, Openings, Stacked Walls, and Families (including elements of Curtain Walls)
mprParametrization.sld5: Strategy processes elements placed in groups. When creating formulas, keep in mind that the target parameter must be able to change across group instances
mprParametrization.sld6: Strategy processes elements located in Rooms
mprParametrization.sld7: Strategy processes elements located in Spaces
mprParametrization.sld8: Strategy processes elements that have Solid geometry and are located in Masses. Masses must have a Solid form
mprParametrization.sld9: Strategy processes elements that have Solid geometry and are located inside other elements that have Solid geometry
mprParametrization.ssd10: Processing elements that touch their solids
mprParametrization.sld10: Strategy processes elements that Solid geometry and have flat solid faces that touch each other
mprParametrization.sld11: Strategy processes elements that are room boundaries
mprParametrization.sld12: Strategy processes elements placed in Structure Connections (Plates, bolts, etc.). Filtering of sub-elements by parameters, as well as the list of parameters of sub-elements in the formula editor, are not provided. Numerical parameters are set without conversion to internal units
mprParametrization.sld13: Strategy processes families that are nested within the parent family
mprParametrization.sld14: Processing Pipe insulation elements and/or Duct insulation elements. It is acceptable not to use a parameter filter for insulation
mprParametrization.ssd15: Processing of rebars in the system
mprParametrization.sld15: Strategy processes rebars as part of reinforcement systems – Area reinforcement and Path reinforcement
mprParametrization.sld16: Strategy processes all materials of the current document regardless of the element selection option
mprParametrization.sld17: Strategy processes elements that are part of an MEP system (electrical system, piping system or duct system). Conditional source element is the element's parent system
mprParametrization.sld18: Strategy processes the components of the Curtain Wall (imposts and panels). Conditional source element is the wall
mprParametrization.ssd19: Processing of elements in relation to specified source elements
mprParametrization.sld19: Strategy processes elements with the possibility to use any specified element of the model as a source element
mprParametrization.sld20: Strategy processes Parts taking into account the source elements from which the Parts are created. If a part is created from several source elements, the first element will be considered the source element
mprParametrization.sld21: The strategy processes elements located in assemblies
mprParametrization.sld22: Processes elements that exist only within a single view and are not part of the 3D model: dimensions, text notes, tags, detail lines and filled regions, and sheet contents. Such elements are bound to the view on which they were created and are not displayed on other views. Model elements such as walls, floors, or equipment are not affected
mprParametrization.sld23: Processes stair components: runs, landings, supports and the railings associated with the stair. The conditional source element is the stair. Components of a multistory stair are processed against the stair they belong to
mprParametrization.sld24: Processes the openings - doors and windows - that face the room. The conditional source element is the room. Openings are taken from the room boundary elements, curtain walls included, and membership is resolved by the To Room and From Room properties in the room phase; when those properties are empty, by the intersection of the opening geometry with the room volume
mprParametrization.ssd25: Processing of two sets of elements matched by value
mprParametrization.sld25: Strategy processes two independent sets of elements - conditionally source and target. A pair is built not by a relation of elements in the model, but by a coinciding value calculated on both sides by the matching setting. Coinciding elements form a group over which aggregate functions are calculated
mprParametrization.sld26: Strategy processes room finishing created by the «Room finishing» plugin. The conditionally source element is a room, the target elements are the finishing elements created for it, including those linked to the room manually by means of the same plugin. Finishing created by any other means is not processed by the strategy
mprParametrization.ssd27: Processing of elements bound to a level
mprParametrization.sld27: Strategy processes elements by their binding to a level. The conditionally source element is a level, the target elements are those located on it. The level is taken from the element property, and if it is not filled in - from the level parameter («Level», «Reference Level», «Base Constraint»). An element stretched between levels (a wall, a column, a stair) belongs to its lower level. Levels are added to processing automatically, there is no need to select them in the model
mprParametrization.sld28: Strategy processes rebars connected by a rebar coupler. The conditionally source element is a coupler, the target elements are one or two rebars its ends are placed on. A coupler placed on a single rebar gives a one to one relation: in this case a rebar value is transferred into the coupler by write back functions. For a coupler placed on two rebars the right part of a write back is calculated for both of them
mprParametrization.tp2: Insert parameter of target family instance

mprParametrization.d-and: Returns TRUE if all conditions <c> are true. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-or: Returns TRUE if at least one condition <c> is true. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-inrange: Returns TRUE if the number <x> is greater than or equal to <min> and less than or equal to <max>. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-has:
Returns TRUE if parameter

exists. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-hasvalue:
Returns TRUE if a value has been assigned to the parameter

at least once. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-firsttrue: Returns the first value of <v> whose <c> condition is true. If all conditions <c> are not true, returns last <v> value
mprParametrization.d-lstr: Returns the specified number of characters from the start of the string
mprParametrization.d-rstr: Returns the specified number of characters from the end of the string
mprParametrization.d-tmirrored: Returns TRUE if the target family is mirrored
mprParametrization.d-smirrored: Returns TRUE if the conditional source family is mirrored
mprParametrization.d-isvertical: Returns TRUE if the axis of the target element is vertical. Otherwise returns FALSE. The optional argument <a> sets the tolerance in degrees, 0.1 by default. The function applies only to elements whose location is defined by a straight line
mprParametrization.d-ishorizontal: Returns TRUE if the axis of the target element is horizontal. Otherwise returns FALSE. The optional argument <a> sets the tolerance in degrees, 0.1 by default. The function applies only to elements whose location is defined by a straight line
mprParametrization.d-strindex: Returns an index counting from zero of the first occurrence of the substring in the string. Returns -1 if the substring is not found in the string
mprParametrization.d-valuestr: Returns the value of the parameter as a string with units
mprParametrization.d-eindex: Returns the index of the successful use of the current formula expression
mprParametrization.d-replace: Returns value in which all occurrences of the given string are replaced by another given string
mprParametrization.d-format: Converts a number to a string using the specified format
mprParametrization.d-cv: Returns the value from the specified cell of the strategy data source
mprParametrization.d-count: Returns the number of times the substring occurs in the string. If the substring is not found in the string, returns 0
mprParametrization.d-lstrindex: Returns an index counting from zero of the last occurrence of the substring in the string. Returns -1 if the substring is not found in the string
mprParametrization.d-not: Returns TRUE if the condition is false. Otherwise returns FALSE
mprParametrization.d-distinct: Returns the differing values of the list, ignoring the start and end spaces when comparing values
mprParametrization.d-cvif: Searches for the first row in the strategy data source (Excel file) where all conditions are met and returns the value from the specified column of that row
mprParametrization.d-cvor: Searches for the first row in the strategy data source (Excel file) where at least one condition is met and returns the value from the specified column of that row
mprParametrization.d-doctitle: Returns the title of the current document
mprParametrization.d-getcurrentviewparameter:
Returns the value of the parameter

of the view on which the processing is performed. Available when processing elements on the current view, on selected views and when processing picked elements
mprParametrization.d-targetbottomz: Returns the lowest elevation (Z) from the geometry of the target element. The elevation is returned in millimeters, rounded to 3 decimal places
mprParametrization.d-targettopz: Returns the highest elevation (Z) from the geometry of the target element. The elevation is returned in millimeters, rounded to 3 decimal places
mprParametrization.d-sourcebottomz: Returns the lowest elevation (Z) from the geometry of the conditional source element. The elevation is returned in millimeters, rounded to 3 decimal places
mprParametrization.d-sourcetopz: Returns the highest elevation (Z) from the geometry of the conditional source element. The elevation is returned in millimeters, rounded to 3 decimal places
mprParametrization.d-gsum: Returns the sum of the expression values over the elements of the group
mprParametrization.d-gcount: Returns the number of group elements of the specified role: "s" - conditional source, "t" - target
mprParametrization.d-gjoin: Joins the expression values over the elements of the group using the specified separator
mprParametrization.d-gmin: Returns the minimum value of the expression over the elements of the group
mprParametrization.d-gmax: Returns the maximum value of the expression over the elements of the group
mprParametrization.d-gavg: Returns the average value of the expression over the elements of the group
mprParametrization.d-gindex: Returns the ordinal number of the target element within the group
mprParametrization.d-ranges: Collapses sequences of consecutive integers into ranges of the form 1-3
mprParametrization.d-ccmin: Returns the minimum value from a column of the strategy data source. Cells whose value cannot be converted to a number are skipped
mprParametrization.d-ccmax: Returns the maximum value from a column of the strategy data source. Cells whose value cannot be converted to a number are skipped
mprParametrization.d-crmin: Returns the minimum value from a row of the strategy data source. Cells whose value cannot be converted to a number are skipped
mprParametrization.d-crmax: Returns the maximum value from a row of the strategy data source. Cells whose value cannot be converted to a number are skipped
mprParametrization.d-item: Returns the list item at the specified zero-based index. Returns an empty value if there is no item with such index
mprParametrization.d-finditem: Returns the first list item that contains the search value. Returns an empty value if there is no such item. The function is case insensitive
mprParametrization.d-itemindex: Returns the zero-based index of the first list item that contains the search value. Returns -1 if there is no such item. The function is case insensitive
mprParametrization.d-trim: Returns the value without leading and trailing spaces
mprParametrization.d-list: Represents a string with the specified separator as a list for membership check by the "=|" and "!=|" operators. Leading and trailing spaces of the items and empty items are dropped
mprParametrization.d-cclist: Returns the values of a column of the strategy data source as a list for membership check by the "=|" and "!=|" operators
mprParametrization.d-crlist: Returns the values of a row of the strategy data source as a list for membership check by the "=|" and "!=|" operators
mprParametrization.d-rgxreplace: Returns value <s> in which every match of the regular expression <s1> is replaced by <s2>. Pattern <s1> is written in double quotes, comes from a parameter value or is the result of a nested function. Group substitutions - "$1", "$2" and so on - are available in <s2>. Case sensitivity is set by the formula option
mprParametrization.d-rgxmatch: Returns TRUE if value <s> contains a match of the regular expression <s1>. Otherwise returns FALSE. Pattern <s1> is written in double quotes, comes from a parameter value or is the result of a nested function. Use the "^" and "$" anchors to match the whole value. Case sensitivity is set by the formula option
mprParametrization.d-wb-avg: Writes the average of the results to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-first: Writes the first result to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-join: Writes the results joined with a separator to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-last: Writes the last result to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-max: Writes the maximum result to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-min: Writes the minimum result to a parameter of the conditional source element
mprParametrization.d-wb-sum: Writes the sum of the results to a parameter of the conditional source element
